name: Beef "Danger Dogs" with Bacon, Onions & Mixed Peppers

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wrap each hot dog with a slice of bacon. (If necessary, use toothpicks to secure bacon to the hot dog at each end.)

Once the skillet is hot, add hot dogs and cook, turning occasionally, until bacon is crisp and hot dogs are warmed through, 5-7 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; slice lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper and set aside.

Wash, dry, trim, and halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Season the cut-side with salt. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add jalapeño peppers, cut-side down, and cook, turning halfway through, until charred, 2-3 minutes. Remove to the plate with the hot dogs and re-cover with foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)
Add bell pepper and onion to the skillet, then season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly charred and fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Fill each bun with a bacon-wrapped hot dog, then top with bell peppers, onions, and jalapeño halves. Drizzle with mustard, mayo, and ketchup (if desired).
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp yellow mustard
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp ketchup

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange assembled hot dogs on a platter and enjoy!
